articles.title: 'No Loyalty To Pak?': Khawaja Asif Sounds Alarm Over Bureaucrats' Exodus To US, Canada, Europe
articles.description: Pakistan may be sinking, and the first to sense it may be its own elite. Defence Minister Khawaja Asif has raised the alarm over what he calls a bureaucratic exodus, accusing senior officers of arranging to settle in Canada, the United States, Britain and Europe while still serving the state. He singled out Portugal, claiming influential officials have prepared their families and finances for relocation, and asked whether they are truly loyal to Pakistan or merely in transit. It is not his first charge: in August 2025, he alleged that over half of the senior bureaucracy had bought property or sought citizenship there. Meanwhile, GDP growth is 3.65 percent, external debt is 137.55 billion dollars and reserves cover two months of imports. The government has published no verified list of those allegedly leaving. articles.title: US Attacks Iran Again! American Strike Hits Konarak Naval Base, Wounds 2 Iranian Soldiers
articles.description: Iran says American forces have carried out a fresh strike on its territory, targeting the Konarak naval base on the country’s southeastern coast and wounding two Iranian servicemen. According to Iran’s Navy, the US military used “two light projectiles” against the facility in Sistan and Baluchestan province, targeting a 35mm naval cannon. The Iranian account indicates the immediate damage was limited, but the location gives the incident wider significance. Konarak sits near Chabahar on the Gulf of Oman, east of the Strait of Hormuz. Iran recently announced an expanded naval deployment posture stretching from Hormuz into the Gulf of Oman and Arabian Sea, while warning that it intends to push American naval forces farther from its coastline. Tehran has also repeatedly warned that renewed US attacks could trigger retaliation against American forces and interests across the region. Iran’s account therefore puts renewed attention on whether and how Tehran responds to the reported strike.#iran #unitedstates #konarak #usiran #iranNavy #centcom #hormuz #gulfofoman #tehran #usmilitary

articles.title: Mark Carney 'Breaks Down' In Parliament After Deadly Fire At Canadian Base
articles.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney addressed Parliament after a devastating fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta killed four soldiers and injured 39 others during a live-fire training exercise. Carney paid tribute to the fallen service members, named the four soldiers who lost their lives, and expressed solidarity with grieving families and wounded troops. He said ferocious winds caused the fire to spread nearly a kilometre in less than a minute. The cause of the blaze remains unknown, and around 50 investigators are working to determine what happened.
